rules: Never reference an asset that does not exist.
Never overwrite a verified scene without a reason.
All scenes must be exactly 5 seconds and 150 frames.
The final video must contain exactly 1800 frames.
All generated visuals must be original or properly licensed.
Do not use copyrighted movie footage or music.
Do not present AI-generated imagery as authentic historical evidence.
Preserve the factual meaning of the approved narration.
Do not use Higgsfield, or any external image- or video-generation service, anywhere in this project.
ElevenLabs is used only for voiceover narration, generated by the user outside this pipeline; the project never calls its API.
All visuals are rendered locally in code at native 1080x1920, 30 fps.

framework._note: Tunables not defined by the original spec; added by the production engineer. Colour names refer to visual_identity keys.

stickman._note: One character design for the whole video. Lengths are in final 1080x1920 pixels.

visuals.source: Original procedural compositions: Python + NumPy + Pillow, animated per frame, encoded by FFmpeg
visuals.remotion: not used - no genuine advantage over the existing Python/FFmpeg pipeline (adds Chromium + npm dependency, slower, less per-pixel control)
